subject: general
question:
which of the following is/ are correct related to Adrenalin hormone ?

(i) Heart beats faster

(ii) Breathing rate increases

(iii) Decreases blood pressure
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (i) and (ii)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Adrenaline, also known as epinephrine, is a hormone and neurotransmitter produced by the adrenal glands.
 
• One of the primary effects of adrenaline is to increase heart rate (i).
 
• Adrenaline also causes an increase in the breathing rate (ii), to supply more oxygen to the muscles.
 
• Contrary to statement (iii), adrenaline actually increases blood pressure by causing the blood vessels to constrict.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fight or Flight Response:** Adrenaline is crucial in the 'fight or flight' response, preparing the body for rapid action in stressful situations.
 
• **Metabolic Effects:** Adrenaline increases glucose production by the liver, providing energy to muscles.
 
• **Adrenergic Receptors:** The effects of adrenaline are mediated through adrenergic receptors, which are found in various tissues throughout the body.
 
• **Medical Use:** Adrenaline is used medically in cases of cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, and severe asthma attacks due to its ability to stimulate heart rate and open airways.
 
• **Side Effects:** Excessive adrenaline can cause side effects such as anxiety, tremors, palpitations, and hypertension.
